svg.title: Iteration space of a 2-D recurrence with wavefronts
svg.desc: A 9 by 9 grid of iterations with arrows to the right and upward; two anti-diagonal wavefronts are highlighted because points on them are mutually independent.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seeing legality: an iteration space with its dependence arrows

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for i, j: a[i][j] = a[i-1][j] + a[i][j-1] — every point needs its left and lower neighbour
